meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Pimple Nilakh | D-SAP Ghule
meta.description: Pimple Nilakh sits between our two JEE centres. The New Sangvi head office is nearer, by way of Sangvi Phata. Faculty from Kota.

h1: IIT JEE coaching in Pimple Nilakh
intro: Pimple Nilakh lies between our two centres. The head office in New Sangvi is the nearer one, about {{commute:pimple-nilakh#km}} km away.

body.text: Take Chandrakant Raoji Jagtap Road and the Aundh-Ravet Road to Sangvi Phata, then the Pimple Gurav-Navi Sangvi Road to Krishna Nagar Road Number 2.

sections.heading: Where Baner crosses over

body.text: The Babasaheb Ambedkar Bridge links Pimple Nilakh with Baner, so students from Baner pass through here on their way to New Sangvi.

body: With our Wakad branch within reach as well, a Pimple Nilakh family has two centres to choose from, by school timings or a sibling's routine.

body.text: Pimple Nilakh students take the two-year route from Class 11 or the one-year route in Class 12, in the evening session from {{fact:batch.timings#start}}.

questions.q: Which of your two centres should we use?
questions.a: New Sangvi is nearer, about {{commute:pimple-nilakh#km}} km. If Wakad suits your day better, that works too: classes run at the same times.

questions.q: What does a batch look like?

a.text: Yes. There are doubt sessions and a doubts forum online.
